attempts.hypothesis: A real API-process death, unlike browser offline, should end the existing reader.
attempts.baseline: LQ1b offline/proxy comparisons did not expose a disconnect.
attempts.result: Niagara author/approve/package and duplicate rest succeeded; owned process stopped 15 seconds, but reader supplied no bytes/end/error and no notice; one request had not reopened.
attempts.decision: Add three-keep-alive byte-liveness cancellation in the actual reader, not a cosmetic banner.

attempts.hypothesis: Wait for stored building recording before opening its area and stopping the API.
attempts.result: Harness stopped before the API comparison: after navigation a no-card confirmation has no selected target ID for discovery, so the confirmation-progress fragment cannot be the reload wait.
attempts.signature: locator.waitFor timeout for 1661 recorded · 0 carded · 0 stopped after navigation.
attempts.decision: Wait for the actual committed package read and initial event bytes, not an invented confirmation listing.

attempts.hypothesis: The byte watchdog should free the old native fetch and allow one replacement transport.
attempts.result: Native reader aborted after silence; tray retained, automatic reconnect and one new request observed. First idle failure was hidden by the ordinary two-failure streak policy, so no notice was observed.
attempts.decision: Classify positively detected idle silence; expose its first failure without changing ordinary bounded-read/reconnect policy.

attempts.hypothesis: Typed idle silence should publish its first notice; wait for a real canonical response rather than treating an empty tile array as loaded.
attempts.result: Notice at 28422 ms, after the API was already restarted; automatic recovery and one open request. No canonical 200 within 60 seconds; WebGL confirmed, screenshot blank, tiles empty, first request aborted.
attempts.decision: Stop both comparisons. Early reconnect notice and loaded drawing remain unqualified; no area-screen change.

attempts.hypothesis: After PV1 lands, the unchanged DA6 original can go from browser hashing through six ordered parts, finalize and existing enrolment.
attempts.prerequisite: PV1 uploadWithoutCitation true; authorized staging merge 520f6c91 and refresh.
attempts.result: Create 201, six part PUTs 200, finalize 200, enrol 201. DOM shows actual checking/uploading/verifying progression. Row preserves oversized-original drafting refusal because LP3b is absent.
attempts.decision: Large retention/enrolment qualified. No large-file layout built or helper author request sent.
